paper_metadata.title: Effects of minor rare earths on the microstructure and properties of Cu-Cr-Zr alloy

evidence.quote: The effects of minor rare earths, such as Sc, Er, and Y, on the microstructure and properties of Cu-Cr-Zr alloys, were studied systematically.
